Spout capture, a camera that's called Telescope on Linux too and every language caught up with the English texts.

## New

- **Spout capture** (Lab). Stream from games, OBS, VTuber programs and 3D tools on the same computer that share their picture through Spout. Each sender shows up in the device picker under its own name and every effect works on it. On Linux it works with Windows programs running under Proton with Spout2PW.

## Changed

- The Linux virtual camera is called **Telescope** now, like on Windows, with **Telescope #2** to **#4** for the extras. An existing setup has the old "Phone Camera" name until you click **Unload** and then **Load** in Settings. Apps like Discord may need the camera picked again after that.
- Tooltips and descriptions are about what you can do with a control, not what it does. Reset buttons only mention what they leave alone when you'd expect otherwise.
- All 16 translations are up to date with the English texts again.

## Fixed

- On Linux the extra cameras are still there after a restart when **Load when the computer starts** is on. Before, they had to be added again every time.
